journey.name: Shake Detection
journey.description: Verifies the shake-detector UI on a physical device: idle state, live accelerometer reading, physical shake recognition, and return to idle.

actions.action: Verify that the app shows "Shake your phone!" and an "Acceleration:" reading near 9.8 (device at rest)
While the phone is being physically shaken, verify that the label changes to "Small Shake Detected!" or "Big Shake Detected!"
Verify that the label returns to "Shake your phone!" within a few seconds after shaking stops
